notes: CoverVerse now chooses one Featured Cover Album per local calendar day and keeps that selection fixed for the day.
Featured albums avoid repeats until the eligible feature pool cycles, then use a fourteen-day repeat guard.
Newly added albums receive a temporary feature boost.
Frequently played albums receive a boost only when Spotify history shows they have not been played within the last seven days.
Feature weighting uses actual cached Spotify play history, including track and album identity; MusicVerse clicks are not treated as listening.
Featured-album history is stored locally for now and can migrate into the existing musicverse_user_feature_history table when Supabase authentication is wired.
